title: MorphoTrace: a browser-based polygon annotation tool for projected-area ground truth

creators.name: Sosa-Trejo, David
creators.affiliation: Universidad de Las Palmas de Gran Canaria (IOCAG) / University of Málaga

description: Dependency-free, client-side web tool to annotate object outlines as polygons (with holes) and export exact projected areas, binary masks and per-image CSV. Images are processed locally and never uploaded. Developed with AI coding assistance (Claude, Anthropic).
